feeds.title: HappierHuman
feeds.description: HappierHuman is all about taking research from positive psychology, the science of happiness, and turning it into actionable steps for a better life. Blog posts cover happiness, mindfulness, optimism, relationships, personal development, positive thinking, relieving stress & anxiety.

feeds.title: Develop Good Habits
feeds.description: Build a Great Life - One Habit at a Time. Like many people, I'm keenly interested in self-improvement , self-publishing, habits, self-help, learning, productivity goal setting.

feeds.title: Becoming Minimalist
feeds.description: Becoming Minimalist inspires others to journey toward simple living. Own less, live more. We are dedicated to rational minimalism and discovering what that uniquely means for us. And the more who are introduced to this life-changing message, the better! Because we're all just trying to make the most of this journey called life.

feeds.title: Tiny Buddha Blog
feeds.description: Tiny Buddha is about reflecting on simple wisdom and learning new ways to apply it to our complex lives - complete with responsibilities, struggles, dreams, and relationships. Founded in 2009, Tiny Buddha has emerged as a leading resource for peace and happiness. The site features stories, tips, and insights from readers of all ages, from all over the globe.

feeds.title: Live Bold & Bloom
feeds.description: Live Bold and Boom covers topics such as boosting confidence, personality type, relationships, self-improvement, self-awareness, life passion, habits, and lifestyle. Barrie Davenport is the founder of the top-ranked self-improvement site, Live Bold and Bloom, established in 2010. The main mission of this page is to give you actionable, easy strategies for improving your life, one small step at a time.

feeds.title: Marc and Angel
feeds.description: Marc and Angel Chernoff are New York Times bestselling authors, professional coaches, full-time students of life, and admirers of the human spirit. The goal of this blog is to give you the tools to identify and transform the limiting beliefs that keep you stuck. Currently, the site contains over 900 articles on happiness, productivity, emotional intelligence, relationships, and general self-improvement,

feeds.title: Verily
feeds.description: True to our name, Verily sifts through the noise of the world to elevate what is honest, real, and beautiful for the modern woman, facilitating her connection with the things that matter the most to her through our production of original media, curation of quality content across the web, and in-person events. We're fostering a movement that doesn't embrace an 'ideal' body type, image, or status, and that doesn't tell a woman how she's supposed to be, but instead empowers her to be who she is.

feeds.title: The Positivity Blog
feeds.description: Find articles on happiness, self-esteem, productivity and social skills. Hi, I'm Henrik Edberg, since 2006 I've written about self-esteem and happiness and much more. I create courses, a blog, and a newsletter about increasing your happiness and awesomeness.

feeds.title: Life Goals Magazine
feeds.description: Life Goals is focused on millennial women who aspire to do more, be more, see more, and learn more. This online magazine is all about consciously choosing to work towards being the best versions of ourselves that we can be. Life Goals was created for a collaborative space where we could showcase voices from around the world and express different experiences and tips on how to be our best selves.

feeds.title: Self-Love Rainbow
feeds.description: Making self-care and self-love part of the everyday. Self-care rainbow teaches you self-love, and self-care, and informs you about mental health. My name is Dominee Calderon and I love colors and rainbows. Brightening up your social media with self-love and self-care.

feeds.title: Uncustomary Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Uncustomary! I believe my life's mission is to make other people happy. I came up with the job title of Merriment Maker because nothing else fit, so I made my own place in the world. I want to help you practice and embody Merriment, love your body and yourself, and tap into something greater than yourself. By joining the Uncustomary Tribe, you'll receive weekly inspiration and motivation for living your best life and accepting who you already are. I'll also give you tips and first dibs on projects, discounts, and more!

feeds.title: The Resilient Blueprint Blog
feeds.description: Explore The Resilient Blueprint blog for insights on recovery from relationship abuse, emotional healing, personal growth, and self-care. Find support, strategies, and inspiration for your healing journey.

feeds.title: Mama, Take Care
feeds.description: Mama Take Care is a self-care blog for moms! I'm Sarah the blogger behind Mama Take Care. I am here to help you on your self-care journey so you can feel less stressed and overwhelmed as a mom and better take care of yourself and your family. I write content on different categories like mommy tips, personal development, self-care, and wellness.

feeds.title: My Self-Love Supply Blog
feeds.description: My Self-Love Supply celebrates and supports self-care, positivity, and healthy living. Our blog is dedicated to inspiring our community on their wellness journey. It was founded in April 2019, by Sofia, as a mental well-being platform on a mission to provide support and resources to practice self-care on a mental, emotional, and physical level.

feeds.title: The At Home Experience Self-Care Blog
feeds.description: Chantel C. Lucier, and her company, The AtHome Experience, are dedicated to educating and enlivening the individual towards greater connection to themselves, each other, and their community. By teaching people how to care for themselves at home, The AtHome Experience aims to empower people to create and sustain optimal health and well-being.

feeds.title: Steven Aitchison
feeds.description: Change Your Thoughts is a must-read blog created by Steven Aitchison to help millions of people around the world to better themselves in any way they can. Steven is an author, crypto investor, and co-Founder of CYT blockchain ventures. A collection of hundreds of personal development articles from psychology, health, relationships, lifestyle, spirituality, and business.

feeds.title: The Blissful Mind Blog
feeds.description: I'm Catherine! I'm here to help you slow down, be mindful, and feel more content with your life. I'm all about making life more blissful, one practical tip at a time. The Blissful Mind is a guide to finding calm in the everyday. Learn how to reduce burnout and overwhelm so you can stress less and take actions.

feeds.title: Wonder Forest
feeds.description: The Wonder Forest Blog is a multi-media creative brand developed by Dana Fox, an artist, and entrepreneur from Canada. Since 2011, the blog has been an online collection of creativity, exploration, and inspiration for women around the world. We share projects, blogs, business tips, advice, and positivity and it is a place of creativity, exploration, and inspiration.

feeds.title: Embracing Simple Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Christina, the creator behind Embracing Simple! My hope is to inspire and encourage those who wish to begin their own journey to living a simple and fulfilling life, as well as provide tips on how to easily manage your finances, household, health, and work life.

feeds.title: Sam Laura Brown
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sam Laura Brown and I'm a perfectionist coach, founder, and creator of the popular group coaching program for perfectionists. Being the host of The Perfectionism Project, one of the top self-help podcasts on iTunes, I guess you'll get out of your own way and become the best version of yourself that you can be. And you're in exactly the right place!

feeds.title: Zen Habits
feeds.description: Zen Habits is about finding simplicity and mindfulness in the daily chaos of our lives. It's about clearing the clutter so we can focus on what's important, create something amazing, and find happiness. Leo Babauta is the Creator of Zen Habits living in San Diego, California.

feeds.title: James Altuchern Blog
feeds.description: James is a Top 10 Linkedin Influencer, prolific writer, successful entrepreneur, chess master, and venture capitalist. He has started and sold several companies and is actively invested in, or advises, over 30 different companies in areas ranging from tech to energy to healthcare to biotech. He is the author of the Wall Street Journal Best Selling books: 'Choose Yourself', and The Power of No (co-author), as well as 'The Choose Yourself Guide to Wealth' (most recent book).
